Shared pen palette UX: glass tray, drawn tools lift on select, ink/highlight presets + up to 6 recent custom colours + «+», 3 widths, finger, undo/redo (ПРЕДЛОЖЕНО)

Compact palette (iPhone, narrow web: popover behind colour dot) and collapsed palette (round glass button)
Palette verification: dsdesign-snapshots pen-*.png and @datascratch/ui «Editor / Document» story + tests
Свой слой рендеринга штрихов поверх TextKit 2 (PKCanvasView cannot anchor to text)
nodes.rationale: PKCanvasView has no text binding; Metal vs Core Animation chosen by latency measurements.
